### Landman (2024) — Power, Greed & The Price of Success 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, a seasoned crisis manager navigating the ruthless oil industry of West Texas. Working between powerful executives, oil-field workers, and dangerous business interests, Tommy must solve problems that can threaten entire operations while keeping himself and his family from getting caught in the chaos.

As the oil business grows, Tommy faces deadly accidents, criminal conflicts, corporate rivalries, and personal struggles that test his judgment. With billions of dollars at stake, everyone wants a bigger share of the profits, but few are willing to accept the consequences. Tommy must rely on his experience, negotiation skills, and ability to read people to survive an industry where one wrong decision can change everything.

The series explores ambition, greed, family loyalty, corruption, and the consequences of chasing wealth. It shows how money can create opportunities while also pushing people into dangerous situations where trust becomes difficult and personal values are put to the test.

What makes Landman compelling is its gritty look at the people behind the oil industry. Beneath the expensive deals and promises of success lies a world filled with pressure, unpredictable enemies, and choices that can cost more than money.

💬 “In a world where everyone wants a piece of the fortune, survival depends on knowing the real price of power.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
